Thanks for the pull request. Please check the boxes below (and note that pull requests containing ROMs, ROM links or extracted game files are rejected).

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` is clean
- [ ] No ROM data, extracted game assets, textures, audio or MIPS assembly from the ROM is committed or linked anywhere in the change
- [ ] `docs/notes/*.md` updated when the change taught something non-obvious
